title: Wisdom of the Crowd, Without the Crowd: A Socratic LLM for Asynchronous Deliberation on Perspectivist Data
reasoning: The paper focuses on using LLMs to facilitate deliberation in data annotation tasks like sarcasm and relation detection. While it includes a section on 'Ethical and Pragmatic Concerns' regarding the deployment of such systems and mentions social bias in the context of data representation, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, moral reasoning, or specific ethical frameworks.
